NOTE
**Still not ready — commit message still breaks the style guide**

New: The author pushed twice, but only shortened the commit title, and the new one is further from the style guide (no space after "web:", lowercase, no period). Missing: a title in the form "area: Capitalized summary." with a more specific area than "web", and a message body explaining why the change is made.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; no reassignment is needed, since laurynmm is already following the PR.

###### Reply

```quote
Not quite yet. Shortening the title isn't enough: it needs the form "area: Capitalized imperative summary." (with a space after the colon, a period at the end, and a more specific area than "web"), plus a body explaining why. Please reread the [commit message guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages) and compare with recent commits in `git log` for these files.
```
